name: estacao-333
description: Estação 3:33 — jogo de detetive em pixel art para desktop (Electron + Steamworks). O jogo em si (game/) é canvas 2D sem dependências.
author: Equipe Estação 3:33

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:game
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:win:portable: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:win:installer: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --linux dir --x64
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --universal
